task: BBBC054 microglial MORPHOLOGY CLASS (not activation state)
dataset_note: Replicate 1 annotates all THREE classes - round, ramified and amoeboid - the three-class task is primary; the two-class round-vs-amoeboid contrast is also reported.
um_per_px_provenance: Leica DMI 6000 with a 20x objective and an Andor AND-DG-152V-C1E-FI camera (BBBC054 page). The Andor Neo 5.5 sCMOS specification gives 2560 x 2160 at 6.5 um pixel pitch; these images are 1080 x 1280 = exactly half in each axis, i.e. 2x2 binning, so the pixel size is 2 x 6.5 / 20 = 0.65 um/px, equal to the common target (resample factor 1.0). The camera model code could not be confirmed by name, so a scale-sensitivity analysis is also reported.
e5_frame_shuffle: N/A: BBBC054 is static, so there is no temporal order to destroy. E5 applies only to tracking and forecasting.
seed_varies: a different stratified cell subsample, a different StratifiedGroupKFold fold assignment, and for E6 a different random-init draw (PLAN_v1.md F3.5)

E1_handcrafted_logreg.note: segmentation + shape + Zernike + Haralick on the mask; logistic-regression probe (the probe every encoder gets)

exposure_time_lofo.cv: leave-one-FOV-out with a +/-3-FOV buffer removed from training, so each test FOV is bracketed by training FOVs on both sides of the time axis
exposure_time_lofo.reading: any leave-one-out scheme shifts the training mean away from the held-out FOV, so a predictor with no time information is anti-ranked (see spearman_rho_cv_mean_predictor). Read rho and MAE against that reference under the same folds; skill > 0 means better than it.
exposure_time_lofo.feature_handling: 0.1-99.9% quantile clipping and RobustScaler fitted on the training fold; non-finite features dropped

three_class.interpretation: balanced accuracy obtainable from exposure time with no image. The sample takes up to the same number of cells of each class from every FOV, so where no class runs out every FOV has equal class counts and time carries no class information BY CONSTRUCTION; any skill above chance here comes from FOVs where a class ran out. It is therefore not a measure of the confound in the data, which is described on the full file in confound_full_file.

round_vs_amoeboid.interpretation: balanced accuracy obtainable from exposure time with no image. The sample takes up to the same number of cells of each class from every FOV, so where no class runs out every FOV has equal class counts and time carries no class information BY CONSTRUCTION; any skill above chance here comes from FOVs where a class ran out. It is therefore not a measure of the confound in the data, which is described on the full file in confound_full_file.

confound_full_file.interpretation: Cramer's V measures how strongly morphology class depends on exposure time in the full annotation file, i.e. the confound before any subsampling
